TokenService._comment: Set PlatformTenantId to your own directory id to try platform administration locally.

TokenSigning._comment: Development-only: signs with the shared development key as the development user issuer, so local services that already trust cho-portal-dev accept these tokens unchanged. Symmetric keys are refused on any host other than Development/Testing. See docs/security/portal-token-service.md.

ChoAuth._comment: Development-only service token for calls to tenant-service.
